nodes.summary: There is exactly one noncrossing partition of $\{0\}$.
nodes.title: Noncrossing partitions of a one-element set

nodes.summary: There are exactly five noncrossing partitions of $\{0, 1, 2\}$.
nodes.title: Noncrossing partitions of a three-element set

nodes.summary: There are exactly two noncrossing partitions of $\{0, 1\}$.
nodes.title: Noncrossing partitions of a two-element set

nodes.summary: There is exactly one noncrossing partition of the empty set, that is, of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ for $n = 0$.
nodes.title: Noncrossing partitions of the empty set

nodes.summary: The discrete noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ is not equal to the indiscrete noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1, 2\}$.
nodes.title: The discrete and indiscrete partitions of a three-element set differ

nodes.summary: The discrete noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1\}$ is not equal to the indiscrete noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1\}$.
nodes.title: The discrete and indiscrete partitions of a two-element set differ

nodes.summary: If a noncrossing partition $P$ of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ has exactly three blocks, then $P$ is the discrete noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1, 2\}$.
nodes.title: A noncrossing partition of three points with three blocks is discrete

nodes.summary: Every noncrossing partition $P$ of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ is the discrete noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1, 2\}$, the indiscrete noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1, 2\}$, or, for some $a \in \{0, 1, 2\}$, the two-block noncrossing partition whose blocks are $\{a\}$ and $\{0, 1, 2\} \setminus \{a\}$.
nodes.title: Classification of noncrossing partitions of a three-element set

nodes.summary: Every noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1\}$ is either the discrete or the indiscrete noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1\}$.
nodes.title: Classification of noncrossing partitions of a two-element set

nodes.summary: If a noncrossing partition $P$ of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ has exactly one block, then $P$ is the indiscrete noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1, 2\}$.
nodes.title: A noncrossing partition of three points with one block is indiscrete

nodes.summary: Every noncrossing partition of the one-point set $\{0\}$ equals the indiscrete noncrossing partition of $\{0\}$.
nodes.title: Noncrossing partitions of one point are indiscrete

nodes.summary: Call a noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ proper if it is not the indiscrete one. Adjoin an extra element $\ast$ to $\{0, 1, 2\}$; this is the bijection from $\{\ast, 0, 1, 2\}$ onto the set of proper noncrossing partitions of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ that sends $\ast$ to the discrete noncrossing partition and each $a \in \{0, 1, 2\}$ to the noncrossing partition with blocks $\{a\}$ and $\{0, 1, 2\} \setminus \{a\}$.
nodes.title: Enumerating the proper noncrossing partitions of three points

nodes.summary: Call a noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1\}$ proper if it is not the indiscrete one. This is the bijection from a one-element set onto the set of proper noncrossing partitions of $\{0, 1\}$, sending its element to the discrete noncrossing partition; in particular the discrete partition is the only proper one.
nodes.title: The proper noncrossing partition of two points

nodes.summary: Every noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ has one, two, or three blocks.
nodes.title: Noncrossing partitions of three points have one, two or three blocks

nodes.summary: The map sending $a \in \{0, 1, 2\}$ to the partition of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ with blocks $\{a\}$ and $\{0, 1, 2\} \setminus \{a\}$ is a bijection from $\{0, 1, 2\}$ onto the set of noncrossing partitions of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ with exactly two blocks.
nodes.title: Enumerating the two-block noncrossing partitions of three points

nodes.summary: For every $a \in \{0, 1, 2\}$, the noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ with blocks $\{a\}$ and $\{0, 1, 2\} \setminus \{a\}$ is different from the indiscrete noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1, 2\}$.
nodes.title: The two-block partitions of three points are not indiscrete

nodes.summary: For $a \in \{0, 1, 2\}$, this is the noncrossing partition of $\{0, 1, 2\}$ whose blocks are $\{a\}$ and $\{0, 1, 2\} \setminus \{a\}$.
nodes.title: Two-block partition of three points

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
